newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait foils attempt to smuggle whisky.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait foils attempt to smuggle whisky.

text.p: Kuwait has foiled an attempt by a flight attendant and an airport soldier to smuggle 70 bottles of whisky into the conservative Gulf Arab state, a newspaper reported on Friday.

Al-Watan newspaper said authorities, acting on a tip, arrested the two men. It said the attendant arrived on a flight from Cairo with the bottles, which the soldier tried to smuggle out of the airport.
Alcoholic beverages are banned in Kuwait, where residents say a bottle of whisky is worth about $120 on the black market.
